children: Munters Group AB updated its medium-term (3–5 years) financial targets, modifying its margin target and adding a return on capital employed target; it retained its average annual growth target. Q3 2026 adjusted ROCE was 11.5%.
Adds adjusted ROCE target; Q3 2026 was 11.5%
The new return target adds a capital-efficiency measure; the release gives a Q3 baseline but not the target value.
The profitability goal has changed, but the release provides no target figure for comparison.
The growth target is unchanged; management says sustaining growth above 14% from the higher base is ambitious yet achievable.

This is an updated medium-term target framework presented at a Capital Markets Day, with data-center growth described as an exceptional near-term contributor to sales. Investors need the full target figures and subsequent reported results to assess progress against the revised margin and ROCE goals.
